name: The Asian Bistro
notes: 2 of 3 photos were menu boards (starters/salads and signature favorites/hot pot/dessert), both clearly legible; 3rd photo was a drinks-only (teas/sodas) menu and was skipped.

dishes.name: Cheesy Wonton
dishes.description: Crispy fried wonton stuffed with water chestnut and cream cheese, served with our house made plum sauce.

dishes.name: House Fried Chicken
dishes.description: Chicken thighs marinated in white pepper then fried to perfection, served with house sweet chili sauce.

dishes.name: Chicken Wings
dishes.description: Crispy fried wings with your choice of sauces: Saigon, Thai, or Mother Chili.

dishes.name: Bulgogi Gyoza
dishes.description: Marinated beef pot stickers, crispy fried and served with soy vinaigrette.

dishes.name: Gyoza
dishes.description: Vegetable, chicken or pork pot stickers, crispy fried and served with soy vinaigrette.

dishes.name: E-Sarn Sausage
dishes.description: Home made E-Sarn style sausage made with ground pork in a mixture of ginger, galangal, lemon grass, chili and herb, served with sticky rice, fresh ginger, fresh lime, fresh serrano chili and peanuts.

dishes.name: Egg Fried Rice
dishes.description: Jasmine rice stir-fried with egg, garlic, onions, peas, and carrots.

dishes.name: Som Tom Lao
dishes.description: Fresh green papaya salad, shredded carrots and cherry tomatoes prepared in a mixture of lime juice, fresh Thai chili, palm sugar and fermented seafood paste.

dishes.name: Som Tom Thai
dishes.description: Fresh green papaya salad, shredded carrots and cherry tomatoes prepared in a mixture of lime juice, fresh Thai chili, palm sugar, fish sauce, and crushed peanuts.

dishes.name: Larb
dishes.description: Choice of protein with fresh cut mint, green onions, cilantro, lime juice, chili, and brown rice powder served with warm sticky rice.

dishes.name: Seaweed Salad
dishes.description: Seaweed, shredded mixed greens, tamarind vinaigrette, crispy onions, and sesame seeds.

dishes.name: Thai Signature Tom Kah
dishes.description: Thai coconut lemongrass soup with mushrooms, spring onions, and choice of protein.

dishes.name: Tom Yum Noodle
dishes.description: Thai-style skinny rice noodle soup with hand-chopped chicken, bean sprouts, lime, crushed peanuts, and chili flakes.

dishes.name: Roasted Duck Noodle
dishes.description: Angel hair noodles with roasted duck, broccoli, spinach, bean sprouts, and duck broth.

dishes.name: Tangerine Chicken
dishes.description: Crispy chicken glazed in signature tangerine sauce, served with Chinese broccoli and carrots.

dishes.name: Sweet Chili Dragon Shrimp
dishes.description: Crispy shrimp tossed in house Mother Chili sauce and finished with spring onions.

dishes.name: Krah Pow
dishes.description: Hand-chopped chicken or pork wok-fired with garlic, onion, bell peppers, basil, and fried egg.

dishes.name: Golden Dragon Duck
dishes.description: Crispy roasted duck tossed in our house garlic sauce, served over Chinese broccoli and carrots.

dishes.name: Panang Salmon
dishes.description: Salmon simmered with bell peppers, broccoli, and carrots in rich panang curry sauce.

dishes.name: Fresh Mango with Coconut Sweet Sticky Rice
dishes.description: Fresh mango served with warm coconut sweet sticky rice.

dishes.name: Banana Caramel Cheesecake Egg Roll
dishes.description: Crispy pastry wrapped around creamy cheesecake and banana finished with cinnamon and caramel.

dishes.name: Fried Banana Drizzled with Honey
dishes.description: Golden-fried banana finished with honey and served warm.

dishes.name: Thai Signature Tom Yum
dishes.description: Hot and sour lemongrass soup with mushrooms, spring onions, and choice of protein.

dishes.name: Egg Drop Soup
dishes.description: Classic Chinese egg soup with peas, carrots, spring onions, and crispy wonton strips.

dishes.name: Hot & Sour Soup
dishes.description: Chinese hot and sour soup with egg, tofu, bamboo shoots, spring onions, and crispy wonton strips.
